verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows BugSnag's own AI analyzing a stack trace, breadcrumbs or commits and proposing a root cause. The official MCP server (bugsnag-probe-3, bugsnag-docs-21) only exposes BugSnag data to external agents, which makes it a building block rather than the platform's AI. Correlated events and error grouping are rule-based features, not AI analysis.
